# Xbyak

Header-only x86/x86-64 JIT assembler used by the PowerPC x86-64 recompiler
(`core/src/cpu/jit/`).

- Upstream: https://github.com/herumi/xbyak
- Version: v7.42 (commit 6207534cb62880c54ce9f6d480ff6d22a9a7b31b)
- License: BSD-3-Clause, see `COPYRIGHT`

Only `xbyak.h`, `xbyak_mnemonic.h` and `xbyak_util.h` are vendored, unmodified.
